investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Emberworks Mutual (insurance); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/us-west-2b/us-west-2c/us-west-2d); network range 10.244.0.0/16; Database: mysql server quotes-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-9a623fbb7d64f9c83; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
